evals.prompt: Audit our student dashboard page for WCAG 3.0 compliance. It has a data table with quiz scores, a progress chart (canvas-based), a navigation sidebar, and interactive filter dropdowns.
evals.expected_output: A WCAG 3.0 audit report identifying accessibility violations in each component with severity ratings, affected user groups, and specific remediation steps
assertions: Response must evaluate each component (table, chart, sidebar, dropdowns) against specific WCAG 3.0 criteria
Response must identify canvas-based chart as a high-risk accessibility barrier and propose alternatives (SVG, ARIA live regions, data table fallback)
Response must classify each finding by severity and specify which disability categories are affected

evals.prompt: Our login form has these issues reported by a screen reader user: the password field has no visible label, the 'Remember me' checkbox lacks an accessible name, and error messages don't announce to screen readers. Fix these.
evals.expected_output: Specific ARIA and semantic HTML remediation for each reported issue with code examples and testing instructions
assertions: Response must provide specific HTML/ARIA fixes for each of the 3 reported issues
Response must include code examples showing the corrected markup with proper label associations and aria-live regions
Response must recommend testing steps with specific screen readers (NVDA, VoiceOver, JAWS) to verify the fixes

evals.prompt: Evaluate our color scheme for accessibility: primary blue #2563EB on white #FFFFFF, error red #DC2626 on light gray #F3F4F6, and secondary text #9CA3AF on white #FFFFFF.
evals.expected_output: A color contrast analysis with WCAG 3.0 contrast ratios for each combination, pass/fail assessment, and alternative color suggestions for failures
assertions: Response must calculate the contrast ratio for each color combination against WCAG 3.0 requirements
Response must identify #9CA3AF on #FFFFFF as failing contrast requirements and suggest compliant alternatives
Response must address color-blind accessibility beyond just contrast ratios

evals.prompt: Design an accessible quiz-taking interface for students with motor disabilities who use switch access or voice control. The quiz has multiple choice, drag-and-drop matching, and timed essay questions.
evals.expected_output: An inclusive design proposal for the quiz interface with alternative interaction patterns for each question type that work with switch access and voice control
assertions: Response must propose keyboard and switch-accessible alternatives for drag-and-drop matching interactions
Response must address timed essay questions with accommodation options for motor-disabled users
Response must ensure all proposed designs maintain functional equivalence with the standard quiz experience

evals.prompt: We're adding a real-time video tutoring feature. What accessibility requirements should we consider for deaf students, blind students, and students with cognitive disabilities?
evals.expected_output: A comprehensive accessibility requirements document for video tutoring covering captioning, audio description, cognitive load management, and interface adaptations for each disability category
assertions: Response must address requirements for deaf users including real-time captioning, sign language interpretation, and visual notifications
Response must address requirements for blind users including audio descriptions, screen reader compatibility, and non-visual interaction
Response must address cognitive accessibility including simplified interface mode, pace control, and attention management

should_trigger: Audit our student dashboard for WCAG 3.0 accessibility compliance
Fix screen reader issues on our login form
Check if our color scheme meets accessibility contrast requirements
Design an accessible quiz interface for students with motor disabilities
What accessibility requirements do we need for our video tutoring feature?
should_not_trigger: Reduce cognitive load on the student dashboard using behavioral science
Run a penetration test on our authentication system
Design a pricing model for our corporate training product
Set up headless browsers for cross-browser visual testing
What emerging AI technologies should we evaluate for education?
